name: GPU Volume Ray Casting (VTK Composite Blend)
aliases: GPU Volume Ray Casting with Composite Blending
definition: A hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique using VTK's vtkGPUVolumeRayCastMapper with composite blending mode to render 3D medical datasets (CT/MRI) by accumulating color and opacity along rays.
summary: GPU Volume Ray Casting (VTK Composite Blend) is a hardware-accelerated direct volume rendering technique that visualizes 3D scalar fields by accumulating color and opacity along rays using standard alpha blending.
